title: Automatic step size of LobattoIIIA4 on the spatial slider crank: the error stays at 1e-7 for the tolerances 1e-5 to 1e-10
author: Claude-JG
description: The solver study (solverConvergenceFigures.py, efficiency_adaptive.png): LobattoIIIA4 with automatic step size on sliderCrank3D of modelLibrary.py takes 21 to 106 steps for the tolerances 1e-5 to 1e-10, but the relative error of the ODE2 coordinates stays at 1.2e-6 to 1.1e-7, while 106 constant steps give about 1e-10 and Radau3 with automatic steps reaches 2e-10. On the other models its error follows the tolerance. To be analyzed: the error estimate twoSteps with the Lie group nodes of the model, a single step with a large error (the first one, or one after a rejection), the interpolated output.
workingRemarks: 2026-11-08 analysis: reproduced (sliderCrank3D, automatic steps from 2e-2, errorEstimate twoSteps): tol 1e-7..1e-10 end error 4.7e-7..1.4e-7 with 33..105 steps, while 105 constant steps would give 5e-10 (constant steps order 3.99). The error is in the rotation of the crank (1.4e-7), grows with time. Radau3 converges with the same nodes; LobattoIIIA4 converges on massOscillator, nPendulum, rigidBodyJoints and on the slider crank with Euler parameter nodes (1.9e-9 at 1e-10, 57 steps). So: LobattoIIIA4 + Lie group nodes (RotVecLG) + changing step size. Not the scaling of the carried-over first stage (a0, z0 are the unscaled last stage). Next: instrument the Lie group stage composition and the explicit first stage across a change of h. Also: both solvers halve the first step 10 times to the minimum 1e-8, the estimate of the first step does not shrink with h.
